text:
marina: NorthBridge opened a dispute on INV-2026-0305. Weekend failover (2026-02-14 23:00 -> 2026-02-15 02:00) produced a $4,200 Dedicated overage on top of their $8,500 commit. They claim the reserved failover pool should have handled it. Dropping here to triage and decide credit approach.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0305 generated for NorthBridge Inc  total $12,700 (overage $4,200). Payment due in 30 days.

emily-acct: CS says customer ran a scheduled DR test and insists their reserved failover capacity was available. They want the overage waived or credited.

rishi-eng: Quick allocation audit shows allocator retries during autoscaler spin-up. Some allocations raced before reserved labels were applied. Example logs:
```
2026-02-15T00:02:11Z ALLOCATE job=northbridge-dr labels={region:us-east1,nodepool:pending}
2026-02-15T00:02:11Z ROUTE -> pool=on-demand
2026-02-15T00:02:12Z NODE_LABEL_APPLY node=node-12 nodepool=reserved-east
```
So metering recorded on-demand because the pool tag wasn't present at initial allocation.

rishi-eng: Root cause looks like an autoscaler + label propagation race. We can push a short-term mitigation (hold allocations until label confirmed) and a longer-term fix in the failover controller.

laura-cs: NorthBridge is important (enterprise commit). They'll accept a partial credit if we pair it with an engineering fix and a signed settlement.

jeff-legal: Legal note 1: avoid admitting liability. If Finance issues goodwill credit, include release language: "one-time settlement; no admission of fault; credit is full satisfaction." Also capture invoice and allocation IDs.

marina: Finance proposal: one-time goodwill credit = 40% of the overage ($1,680) + offer 1 month waived overages up to $1,500 as gesture (max concession $3,180). Keeps precedent limited. Approve?

tia-cfo: Approve the proposed goodwill credit + 1mo waiver cap. Finance to coordinate release language with Legal and collect signed acceptance via CS.

emily-acct: I'll send settlement template to NorthBridge this afternoon and request sign-off. Engineering, can you produce an attribution CSV for the disputed window (allocation IDs, timestamps, measured SKU)?

rishi-eng: Yes, will produce the CSV and open ticket INFRA-5910 (label-propagation fix + allocation hold). ETA: CSV in 24h, patch behind feature flag in 72h.

marina: Finance will draft provisional credit memo and queue manual adjustment once signed settlement arrives. Leaving thread open until CS posts signed doc and Billing posts the credit memo.
